method: All eight PNGs inspected at original resolution with view_image.

materialIssues.description: With inherited RTL and English fallback labels, individual isolated node names do not preserve the visual label/node pairing. Red collector and Black emitter render as emitter Red collector · Black; the Black label is detached from its node.
materialIssues.recommendation: Isolate each complete translated label plus node pair using an automatic-direction wrapper, retain left-to-right isolation on each node, and keep the separator outside the two pairs.

observations: Ordinary desktop/390/320, mixed sensor/probe, actual 200% and localized views remain clear.
At 200%, current magnitudes and captured inputs/light stay intact, with the disclosure indicator separate.
Forced colors keep labels and actions clear.
The automated audit passed eight scans; this visual finding is additional and is not overridden by those automated results.
